summary: Appointment schedule by room and doctor.
purpose: To book, move, confirm, cancel and reassign appointments, find free slots and leave internal reminders. Each appointment shows on its room's calendar; the appointment menu (right-click) gathers status changes, editing, patient details and reassignments. Requires branches, schedules, rooms, doctors with availability and services.
tips: Right-clicking an appointment opens its menu: status, edit, delete, color, doctor, room, move to another day and duration.
Drag an appointment to change its time or room; stretch its edge to change the duration.
Click a free slot to create an appointment right there, or right-click to create a reminder or a note.
Canceling is not deleting: a cancellation with its reason stays in the history and in the reports; deleting is for appointments entered by mistake.
Bulk operations reassign many appointments to another doctor at once (vacations, leave).
The default view, grouping, hour size and booking rules are set in Calendar settings (gear); they are per user and save automatically.

appointments.filter.appointments.description: Patient's name, phone, email or ID, or the appointment title.

appointments.btn.gaps.label: Find free slots
appointments.btn.gaps.description: Free times on the visible days.

appointments.section.gaps.label: Available slots
appointments.section.gaps.description: Choosing one opens the appointment at that time.

appointments.btn.bulk.label: Bulk operations
appointments.btn.bulk.description: Select several appointments and reassign them.

appointments.btn.settings.label: Calendar settings
appointments.btn.settings.description: Visible hours, slots, how appointments are created and grouping.

appointments.section.calendar.label: Calendar
appointments.section.calendar.description: Click a free slot to book; right-click for a reminder or note.

appointments.section.event.label: Appointment
appointments.section.event.description: Right-click: appointment menu. Drag: move. Edge: duration.

appointments.btn.status-confirmed.label: Confirmed
appointments.btn.status-confirmed.description: The patient said they are coming.

appointments.btn.cancel-menu.label: Cancel…
appointments.btn.cancel-menu.description: No notice, by the clinic or another reason.

appointments.btn.change-color.label: Change color
appointments.btn.change-color.description: Background colour of the appointment in the calendar; "No background" leaves it without its own colour (it shows the room or practitioner colour).

appointments.btn.move-to.label: Move to
appointments.btn.move-to.description: Another day with the same time and duration.

appointments.btn.reschedule.label: Reschedule
appointments.btn.reschedule.description: Cancels the appointment and creates a new one with the edited details.

appointments.btn.patient-menu.label: Patient
appointments.btn.patient-menu.description: Account, history, files, appointments and details.

appointments.field.services.label: Service
appointments.field.services.description: Sets the duration and what is billed.

appointments.section.settings.label: Calendar Settings
appointments.section.settings.description: Each user's calendar preferences; they save automatically.

appointments.field.calendar-mode.label: View (Mode)
appointments.field.calendar-mode.description: Invoke shows the calendar as usual. Custom shows one calendar at a time in full screen; use the 'Calendars' button (top left) to choose which one to view.

appointments.field.default-view.label: Default view
appointments.field.default-view.description: Sets which view opens with the calendar (day, week, month, agenda…). Changing it applies the view right away.

appointments.field.grouped-by.label: Group by
appointments.field.grouped-by.description: Splits the calendar into columns by doctor or by room. 'No grouping' shows a single combined column.

appointments.field.default-sede.label: Branch
appointments.field.default-sede.description: Limits the calendar to one branch's rooms. 'All branches' shows every room.

appointments.field.hour-height.label: Hour height
appointments.field.hour-height.description: Vertical space for each hour in the day and week views. Taller = more space between appointments and more visible free gaps. Zoom multiplies this value and the slot duration divides it: below it shows how many pixels each slot ends up measuring.

appointments.field.slot-duration.label: Slot duration
appointments.field.slot-duration.description: Length of each slot (10, 15, 20, 30 min or 1 h). Sets how many slots fit in an hour: the more slots, the thinner they are within the configured hour height. If they're too tight, raise the hour height or the zoom.

appointments.field.event-label-format.label: Appointment format
appointments.field.event-label-format.description: Sets how the text shown on each appointment is built (time, patient, treatment, notes).

appointments.field.hidden-weekdays.label: Hide days
appointments.field.hidden-weekdays.description: Hides the chosen days as columns in the day and week views. It's only visual, to save space: it doesn't affect availability or the days appointments can be booked.

appointments.field.color-by-status.label: Color by status
appointments.field.color-by-status.description: Appointments show their status with color. If the appointment has its own color label or its service's color, it keeps it and the status shows as a strip on the left edge. If it only inherits the doctor's or room's color, the whole appointment is painted with the status color. Some statuses are set to always paint the appointment regardless of this preference — see Setup → Calendar Colors.

appointments.field.check-availability.label: Check availability
appointments.field.check-availability.description: When creating/editing an appointment, checks that the time is available for the chosen doctor or room.

appointments.field.block-unavailable.label: Block outside office hours
appointments.field.block-unavailable.description: Dims and blocks the times outside office hours on the calendar (according to schedules and exceptions), so appointments can't be created there.

appointments.field.filter-doctors-by-ser.label: Filter doctors by service
appointments.field.filter-doctors-by-ser.description: When creating an appointment, filters the doctor list to show only those who provide the selected service.

appointments.field.inline-appointment-cr.label: Create appointment on the calendar
appointments.field.inline-appointment-cr.description: Clicking a slot creates the appointment right on the calendar with a card, without opening the dialog. The Create button always opens the dialog.

appointments.field.inline-draft-live-pre.label: Preview the appointment
appointments.field.inline-draft-live-pre.description: The inline appointment card opens next to the appointment, which shows on the calendar while you fill it in, so you can see how it fits in the gaps. Changing the date moves the calendar to that day. Tablet and desktop only.

appointments.btn.future-confirm.label: Yes (confirm the new time)
appointments.btn.future-confirm.description: Warning about the patient's existing appointments: "Yes" saves the new appointment anyway; "No" goes back to the form.

appointments.btn.slot-enable.label: Enable hours…
appointments.btn.slot-enable.description: In the right-click menu of a closed time: opens those hours for that day only, as an exception schedule.

appointments.enable-slot.field.start_tim.label: From
appointments.enable-slot.field.start_tim.description: Start of the hours to enable.

appointments.enable-slot.field.end_time.label: To
appointments.enable-slot.field.end_time.description: End of the hours to enable; it must be after the start.

appointments.btn.missing-document-open.label: Got it (missing document)
appointments.btn.missing-document-open.description: Notice when the appointment can't move to a status because the patient has no document: opens their details to add it.

appointments.btn.missing-document-dismis.label: Close
appointments.btn.missing-document-dismis.description: Dismisses the missing document notice without opening the patient's details.

appointments.field.identity_document.label: ID document
appointments.field.identity_document.description: In the patient's details opened from the appointment.
